title: Customer-Facing Intake: 'Signal Binder' — Automate Sales/CS Request Bundling and First-Pass Costing
creator: Aisha Verma
description: Problem: Sales and CS submit many discrete enterprise feature requests that overlap across accounts and use cases. Triage today is manual, inconsistent, and slow; PMs often spend >3 hours per major bundle to estimate feasibility and unit economics. Goal: build a lightweight 'Signal Binder' that automatically clusters incoming enterprise asks, surfaces a single prioritized bundle per cluster, and produces a defensible first-pass economic sizing and technical risk score to accelerate PM/Eng intake. Scope: 1) ingestion normalization for Sales/CS forms and email threads; 2) clustering heuristics (semantic similarity + account overlap + impact tags); 3) first-pass costing model (engineering hours proxy, infra unit cost, likely SLA tier); 4) generated PRD skeleton and one-slide econ summary for exec review. Out of scope: detailed engineering design, final scoping with customers, or automated commitments to Dedicated/Private capacity.
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with CS and Sales leadership. Agreed success metric: reduce PM first-pass triage time from median 5 days to <24 hours for bundles with >3 similar asks.

2026-03-04: Drafted intake normalization schema and canonical fields (use case, affected endpoints, rough QPS, data residency). Posted to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/Signal+Binder+Intake+Schema

2026-03-05: Prototype clustering run on last 12 months of CS tickets. Result: 18% of requests map into 5 recurring clusters; manual review showed 76% precision. Notebook and sample output in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/signal-binder/prototype

2026-03-06: Trade-off discussion with Eng: prefer interpretable heuristics (TF-IDF + named-entity account overlap) over end-to-end embedding clustering for explainability to Sales. Decision: hybrid approach — embeddings for initial grouping, rules for final bucket assignment.
2026-03-07: Eng lead (Diego) requested API contract for bundle payload. Added to repo as an RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/signal-binder/pull/12

2026-03-08: Ran a tabletop with 3 AEs and 2 CS managers using sample bundles; feedback: require a "business-critical" toggle and suggested adding estimated revenue impact field. Updated intake form draft in Drive.

2026-03-09: Mock PRD skeleton auto-generated by prototype shared with Design for one-slide econ visual. Design feedback: simplify to three tiles (user pain, dev lift, estimated net unit cost). Confluence link updated.

2026-03-10: Prioritized scope for MVP: ingestion normalization, clustering pipeline, econ heuristic, generated PRD skeleton. Blockers: legal review for storing redacted customer excerpts, and small infra quota for running clustering nightly. Open Slack thread: #pm-signal-binder
acceptance_criteria: Automatically ingest Sales/CS requests from two sources (Zendesk form + GH issue template) and normalize to canonical schema within 2 hours of submission
Cluster algorithm groups >20% of incoming requests into recurring bundles with precision >= 70% on a held-out test set
Generated bundle package includes a 1-paragraph problem statement, list of affected customers, estimated 1st-pass engineering hours, and a single-slide econ summary
PMs can mark a generated bundle as 'Ready for Scoping' or 'Needs More Info' via Console; review flow implemented in Console-2026.04 release
Median PM triage time for bundled requests falls under 24 hours in pilot accounts (measured over 2-week pilot)
risks: Overclustering: unrelated asks incorrectly merged leading to wrong prioritization; mitigation: conservative thresholds and human-in-the-loop review
Econ heuristics may under/overestimate engineering lift for cross-team work; mitigation: surface uncertainty bands and a 'confidence' score
Legal/compliance concerns about storing customer PII in prototypes; mitigation: redaction pipeline and legal review before production
Sales adoption risk if generated bundles appear to deprioritize high-touch accounts; mitigation: include account-priority toggle and manual override
next_steps: Complete legal redaction checklist by 2026-03-14 (owner: Legal, copied: PM + Eng)
Eng to deliver v0 API and nightly clustering cron by 2026-03-17 (owner: Diego)
Run closed pilot with 4 high-touch AE teams for two weeks starting 2026-03-22
Design to deliver econ one-slide component and PRD template by 2026-03-16
Prepare metrics dashboard for triage time and bundle precision; dashboard owners: Observability + PM
